description: Goal: make GC/allocation pressure independent from scheduler fairness. Allocation may mark heap GC-needed and grow blocks, but it must not expire the process reduction budget or create allocation-pressure yields. Signal: allocation-heavy loops yield only by reduction count, while boundary GC still runs from heap pressure. Strategy: remove the heap owner/budget-expiry path, simplify yield accounting, update tests and runtime docs/guides.
title: Runtime GC pressure must not force scheduler yields
